basic.name: Sinister Strike
basic.description:
Dash forward, hitting all enemies in a line for 110~~0.04~~ damage. If Sinister Strike hits a Hero, Valeera stops dashing immediately and the cooldown is reduced to 1 second.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Stealth: Ambush
Heavily damage an enemy and reduce their Armor.

basic.name: Blade Flurry
basic.description:
Deal 130~~0.04~~ damage in an area around Valeera. 

Awards 1 Combo Point per enemy Hero hit.

Stealth: Cheap Shot
Stun, Blind, and damage an enemy.

basic.name: Eviscerate
basic.cooldown:
Cooldown: 1 second
Consumes all Combo Points
basic.description:
Eviscerate an enemy, dealing damage per Combo Point. 

1 Point: 85~~0.04~~
2 Points: 170~~0.04~~
3 Points: 255~~0.04~~

Stealth: Garrote
Silence and damage an enemy over time.

basic.name: Ambush
basic.description:
Ambush an enemy, dealing 130~~0.04~~ damage and reducing their Armor by 10 for 5 seconds.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Sinister Strike
Dash forward, damaging enemies.

basic.name: Cheap Shot
basic.description:
Deal 30~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy, Stun them for 0.75 seconds, and Blind them for 2 seconds once Cheap Shot's Stun expires.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Blade Flurry
Deal damage in an area around Valeera.

basic.name: Garrote
basic.description:
Deal 20~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and an additional 140~~0.04~~ damage over 7 seconds, and Silence them for 2.5 seconds.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Unstealth: Eviscerate
High damage finishing move.

heroic.name: Cloak of Shadows
heroic.description:
Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

heroic.name: Smoke Bomb
heroic.description:
Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

trait.name: Vanish
trait.description:
Vanish from sight, becoming Stealthed, gaining 20% Movement Speed and access to new Abilities. For the first second, Valeera is Unrevealable and can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

After being Stealthed for 3 seconds, the cast range of Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote is increased from 2.5 to 5, and they cause Valeera to teleport to the target when used.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: Teleports you back to the Altar, instantly restoring you to full Health.

activable.name: Crippling Poison
activable.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds.

Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.

activable.name: Wound Poison
activable.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds.

Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

activable.name: Thistle Tea
activable.description:
Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy.

Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

level1.name: Vigor
level1.description:
Valeera regenerates an additional 3 Energy per second.

Reward: After Gathering 20 Regen Globes, increase Valeera's maximum Energy to 120.

level1.name: Subtlety
level1.description: After teleporting with Ambush, Cheap Shot, or Garrote, regenerate 10 Energy per second for 5 seconds.

level1.name: Combat Readiness
level1.description: Each Combo Point spent grants 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

level1.name: Crippling Poison
level1.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds.

Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.

level4.name: Relentless Strikes
level4.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 10.

level4.name: Hemorrhage
level4.description: Valeera's Basic Attacks deal 40% additional damage to enemies affected by Garrote.

level4.name: Initiative
level4.description: Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote grant 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and award 2 Combo Points.

level4.name: Wound Poison
level4.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds.

Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

level7.name: Mutilate
level7.description: Sinister Strike now hits with both blades, dealing 125% additional damage, but its range is reduced by 1.

level7.name: Fatal Finesse
level7.description:
Quest: Each time Blade Flurry damages an enemy Hero, its damage increases by 6, up to 90.

Reward: After damaging 15 Heroes with Blade Flurry, permanently reduce its Energy cost by 20.

level7.name: Slice and Dice
level7.description:
Eviscerating an enemy with 3 Combo Points grants 400% Attack Speed. Lasts 3 seconds or 3 Basic Attacks.

Passive: Basic Attacks restore 2 Energy.

level10.name: Smoke Bomb
level10.description:
Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

level10.name: Cloak of Shadows
level10.description:
Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

level13.name: Death From Above
level13.description: Teleporting with Ambush reduces the cooldown of Vanish by 4 seconds.

level13.name: Blind
level13.description: Increase the duration of Cheap Shot's Blind by 2.5 seconds.

level13.name: Strangle
level13.description: Using Garrote on a Hero reduces their Spell Power by 40% for 6 seconds.

level16.name: Seal Fate
level16.description: Sinister Strike deals 50% additional damage and generates an additional Combo Point when used against Silenced, Rooted, or Stunned enemy Heroes.

level16.name: Assassinate
level16.description: Ambush deals 50% additional damage and reduces the target's Armor by an additional 10 if no other enemy Heroes are within 4 range of the victim.

level16.name: Thistle Tea
level16.description:
Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy.

Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

level20.name: Adrenaline Rush
level20.description: While in the Smoke Bomb, Valeera regenerates an additional 40 Energy per second.

level20.name: Enveloping Shadows
level20.description: Whenever Valeera uses Vanish, she also gains Cloak of Shadows.

level20.name: Rupture
level20.description: Increase Garrote's damage over time by 100%. Valeera's Basic Attacks refresh the duration of Garrote.

level20.name: Elusiveness
level20.description: Increases Valeera's Movement Speed while Vanished by an additional 20%.
